releases.name: supervisor-workflow
releases.description: The supervisor and its toolbox shipping loop run reliably.

clusters.title: Ship destination identity and stacked PR ancestry
clusters.description: Bounded correction to the session-recovery path (CIT-527): a recovered agent_ship must match the environment and the requested destination branch. The same cluster states the stacked-PR rule: a child issue's PR targets its open parent's branch, targets main once the parent has merged, and fails explicitly when ancestry is missing or ambiguous.
